svg.title: Three ways to compute exp
svg.desc: StrictMath.exp gives fdlibm's bits on every CPU, one double per call. VectorOperators.EXP works on a vector and promises an accuracy bound, not StrictMath's bits; on common data on the Xeon 8573C it is 15.38 times as fast as StrictMath. VFdlibm.exp works on a vector and gives StrictMath's bits in every lane; there it is 6.73 times as fast.
